name: CPH & Associates
one_liner: Occurrence-form malpractice insurance for counselors, therapists, social workers, psychologists and students.
short_description: Individual professional liability insurance for mental-health clinicians and students, written on an occurrence form with licensing board defense and online applications.
long_description: CPH & Associates (CPH Insurance) sells individual professional liability insurance to counselors, psychotherapists, marriage and family therapists, clinical social workers and psychologists, including associate-level, provisionally licensed and student clinicians; it also insures some allied-health and wellness professions. Policies are written on an occurrence form, which CPH describes as lifetime coverage for incidents during the policy period, so tail coverage is not needed. Limits of $1M per occurrence / $3M aggregate or $1M / $5M are offered, and CPH states defense costs are unlimited and paid outside the limits. Licensing board defense is included up to $35,000, with options to raise it, and policyholders get up to two free hours of attorney consultation per policy period through its Avoiding Liability Helpline. CPH says its carrier is rated A++ by A.M. Best but does not name the carrier on the pages we reviewed. Cyber liability can be added in most states. Quotes and proof of coverage are available online, with a 5% discount for applying online (not in Tennessee or Maine). Many state and national counseling and MFT associations route members to CPH programs.
best_for: Licensed counselors, LMFTs and LCSWs buying their own individual policy
Pre-licensed associates and interns who need coverage while under supervision
Clinicians who want occurrence coverage so they never need to buy tail
Members of counseling or MFT associations that partner with CPH
not_for: Psychiatrists and other prescribers, who need a medical malpractice program
Group practices looking for one entity policy covering the practice
Clinicians who want the underwriting carrier named up front before applying

faqs.q: Is CPH malpractice insurance occurrence or claims-made?
faqs.a: CPH writes its mental-health policies on an occurrence form, which it describes as lifetime coverage for incidents during the policy period, so tail coverage is not needed.
$1,000,000 per occurrence with a $3,000,000 aggregate, or $1,000,000 / $5,000,000. CPH states defense costs are unlimited and not deducted from the limits.

faqs.q: Does CPH cover licensing board complaints?
faqs.a: Yes. CPH lists up to $35,000 for expenses from a licensing board or regulatory investigation, with options to increase it.

faqs.q: Can students and associates get CPH coverage?
faqs.a: Yes. CPH insures students, provisionally licensed interns and associates as well as fully licensed clinicians. Students and supervised clinicians do not qualify for discounts until licensed.
